verdict.rationale: YPOG's materials cover related equity topics—ESOP/VSOP taxation (Section 19a GITA, Future Financing Act), convertible instruments for early-stage financing, and German cap-table particularities in its Venture Deals guide—and it offers GmbH/UG formation notary forms. However, none of the evidence specifically addresses founder-to-founder equity splits, founder vesting schedules, or an 83(b)-equivalent election for founders (the cited tax deferral provisions are framed around employee stock plans, not co-founder day-zero equity allocation). Missing for 10: explicit founder vesting-schedule guidance, founder-specific tax election content (vs. employee ESOP focus), and worked examples of co-founder equity split structuring.
